capabilities.$comment: Per-tier (server=anchor+gazetteer; pocket=anchor-only) × address-system × tag capability manifest (#718/#719). maskOffF1 = measured per-tag exact-match F1 with the conventions mask OFF; maskOnF1 = the same with mask ON (recorded only for tags some codex forbiddenTags row suppresses — the loader's delta-gate consults only those). createScorer FAILS CLOSED when a conventions row forbids a tag with maskOffF1 − maskOnF1 > 0.05 (the mask provably destroys a real capability). Generated by `mailwoman eval capability-manifest` against the v1.5.0 int8.

fisher_artifact.$comment: The consolidation artifact (v8.3.0 D4/#1354): diagonal empirical Fisher over the base run's final 2,000 steps, covering all 39,261,743 trainable parameters. The EWC brake input for every fine-tune off this base (train.ewc_fisher_path). HF/R2-distributed ONLY — the runtime never reads it, so it stays out of the npm tarball.

us_artifacts.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R5 (2026-08-01). The US instance of the placetype-pair prior — the first non-postal-register one.

pair_index_us_bin.format: PIX1 placetype-pair index — a retrieval-augmented (child, parent) dependent_locality prior, e.g. ("Park Slope", "Brooklyn")
pair_index_us_bin.source: Who's On First admin hierarchy ($MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT/wof/admin-global-priority.db). NO postal register: USPS routes city/state/ZIP, so unlike GB's PPD there is no mail source carrying US dependent localities. Children: borough + neighbourhood. Parents: locality, localadmin AND borough — WOF parents US neighbourhoods to the locality ("Astoria" hangs off New York, not Queens), so a locality-only parent rule drops the borough-level pairs this instance exists for.
pair_index_us_bin.delta_calibration: δ=10, transitionBeta=5 — inherited from the GB calibration rather than re-swept, because the R5 finding is that the classifier's dependent_locality deficit is UNIFORM across locales (~7.0 logits mean, measured on the en-gb card), not GB-specific. The R5 bars were measured at exactly this pair; changing either number invalidates them.
pair_index_us_bin.country_gate: hard-gated on the header's country (us). Verified inert on GB input: the index misses all five GB canonical pairs (Shoreditch/London, Nine Elms/London, Clapham/London, Camden/London, Didsbury/Manchester) — see neural/test/weights.test.ts.
pair_index_us_bin.not_committed: derived artifact, .gitignore'd (same posture as postcode-us.bin) — rebuilt via `mailwoman gazetteer pair-index --out neural-weights-en-us --country us --delta 10 --transition-beta 5 --borough-db <wof/admin-global-priority.db>`
pair_index_us_bin.behavior_change: This changes DEFAULT en-us parse output. A US address carrying a neighbourhood or borough line previously emitted no dependent_locality AND SILENTLY DROPPED the second admin level ("123 Main St, Park Slope, Brooklyn, NY" → locality=Park Slope, Brooklyn discarded). It now emits dependent_locality=Park Slope, locality=Brooklyn.
pair_index_us_bin.$comment_md5: REPRODUCIBILITY: a PIX1 header embeds `buildDate`, so a rebuild from identical sources produces different bytes and a different md5. This md5 therefore identifies the artifact STAGED TO HUGGING FACE for this release — it is a provenance record of the shipped bytes, NOT a check a local rebuild can reproduce. A mismatch after rebuilding is expected and is not corruption; verify pair COUNT and header delta/beta instead.
